from pathlib import Path
import ast
import difflib
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import subprocess

manifest = json.loads(Path('/tmp/astra-pass96-inputs.json').read_text())
def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def text_hash(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
for path, expected in manifest['hashes'].items():
    assert digest(path) == expected, path
bindings = 0
for document in manifest['binding_documents']:
    for path, expected in re.findall(r'\| `([^`]+)` \| `([0-9a-f]{64})` \|', Path(document).read_text()):
        assert digest(path) == expected, (document, path)
        bindings += 1
r = json.loads(Path('research/astra-minimal-failure-deletion-root-verification.json').read_text())
assert digest(r['source_path']) == r['source_sha256'] == text_hash(r['source_text'])
assert text_hash(r['worker_returned_source_text']) == r['worker_returned_source_sha256']
for key in ['root_helper_receipt', 'worker_receipt']:
    assert digest(r[key]['path']) == r[key]['sha256']
for key in ['compile', 'axiom_probe']:
    run = r[key]
    assert run['exit_code'] == 0 and run['stderr'] == ''
    assert text_hash(run['source_text']) == run['source_sha256']
    assert run['cgroup']['memory.max'] == '4294967296'
    assert run['cgroup']['memory.swap.max'] == '536870912'
    assert int(run['cgroup']['memory.peak']) < 4294967296
    assert run['cgroup']['memory.swap.peak'] == '0'
    assert '-j1' in run['argv']
    assert 'subprocess.run' in run['script_source']
assert r['compile']['source_sha256'] == r['source_sha256']
assert r['compile']['stdout'] == ''
for fragment in ['MemoryMax=4G', 'MemorySwapMax=512M', 'TasksMax=128',
                 '/usr/bin/flock', '.lake/verification.lock']:
    assert fragment in r['command_prefix']
required = {'LonelyRunner.MinimalPositiveIntegerFailure.' + name for name in
            ['two_le_count', 'deletion_seed_interval', 'exists_common_deletion_margin']}
reports = re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^]]*)\]", r['axiom_probe']['stdout'])
assert len(reports) == 3 and {name for name, _ in reports} == required
for name, axioms in reports:
    assert {item.strip() for item in axioms.split(',') if item.strip()} <= {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}, name
assert r['axiom_probe']['source_text'].splitlines()[0] == 'import LonelyRunner.MinimalFailureDeletion'
worker = json.loads(Path(r['worker_receipt']['path']).read_text())
assert [a['exit_status'] for a in worker['attempts']] == [1, 1, 1]
for attempt in worker['attempts']:
    assert text_hash(attempt['source_text']) == attempt['source_sha256']
    assert attempt['raw_output_status'] == 'complete_actual_combined_tool_output'
    assert 'error:' in attempt['combined_stdout_stderr_raw']
assert worker['attempts'][-1]['source_sha256'] == r['worker_returned_source_sha256']
helper = json.loads(Path(r['root_helper_receipt']['path']).read_text())
assert [a['exit_code'] for a in helper['attempts']] == [1, 0]
for attempt in helper['attempts']:
    assert text_hash(attempt['source_text']) == attempt['source_sha256']
assert worker['root_helper_binding']['source_sha256_before_adapter'] == helper['attempts'][-1]['source_sha256']
old = r['worker_returned_source_text'].splitlines(keepends=True)
new = r['source_text'].splitlines(keepends=True)
assert ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old, new, fromfile='Terra final ee7fefd',
                                  tofile='root compiled2c9b11')) == r['root_diff']
changed = sum(max(j-i, l-k) for op, i, j, k, l in
              difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, old, new).get_opcodes() if op != 'equal')
assert changed == r['root_full_assembly_changed_lines'] == 16
assert r['root_helper_added_lines'] == helper['root_source_lines_added'] == 46
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('trust', 'scripts/audit_lean_trust.py')
trust = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(trust)
sources = [Path('LonelyRunner.lean'), *sorted(Path('LonelyRunner').rglob('*.lean'))]
for source in sources:
    assert not trust.source_has_forbidden_constructs(source.read_text()), source
assert 'import LonelyRunner.MinimalFailureDeletion' in Path('LonelyRunner.lean').read_text().splitlines()
audit = Path('LonelyRunner/AxiomAudit.lean').read_text().splitlines()
tree = ast.parse(Path('scripts/audit_lean_trust.py').read_text())
sets = [ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
        and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'required_probes' for t in n.targets)]
assert len(sets) == 1 and required <= sets[0]
for name in required:
    assert audit.count('#print axioms ' + name) == 1
subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check'], check=True)
for path in manifest['new_text_files']:
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    assert text.endswith('\n') and not re.search(r'[ \t]+$', text, re.M), path
print(json.dumps({'frozen_hashes': len(manifest['hashes']), 'document_bindings': bindings,
                  'lean_sources_scanned': len(sources), 'required_new_axiom_probes': 3,
                  'worker_failed_sources_bound': 3, 'root_helper_attempts_bound': 2,
                  'root_full_compile_and_axiom_probe': 'passed, source and raw receipts bound',
                  'scope': 'Local integration and evidence verification; hosted full build pending. Unrestricted LRC unresolved.'}, indent=2))
